title: Literally dies on you
text: Literally dies on you. What is wrong with people. I only used this earlier this year and it worked great then. I just started using it again a few days ago and the following occurs: * heat setting gets too hot for the setting selected, * the timer shuts off when it feels like it and * then it simply doesn't work; the light on the remote is on but no heat. The sad thing is that not one company does this either. It simply tells me what the US has come to; making money at the expense of others without concern or pride of the product they make. Pathetic.
